message.content:
Chunky knitted sweater with a relaxed silhouette, cropped at the hip, color #d9bf88, wool blend.
High-waisted wide-leg trousers with a soft drape, ankle length, color #deb295, stretch cotton twill.
Minimalist leather ankle boots with a low block heel, color #759087, smooth calfskin.
This ensemble strikes the perfect balance between comfort and refinement for a full day of walking on cobblestones in an autumn park. The warm tones of the sweater and trousers complement your skin naturally while the wide-leg cut allows your legs to move freely without restriction. Textured knitted fabric adds necessary warmth against the cool air, while the sturdy leather boots provide the stability needed for uneven terrain.
